تجنوا (form I)
# تَجُنُّوا (tajunnū) /ta.d͡ʒun.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of جَنَّ (janna)
# تُجَنُّوا (tujannū) /tu.d͡ʒan.nuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of جَنَّ (janna) and جُنَّ (junna)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
